fullPassage:
As president of our school’s volunteer club, I, Luke Peres, was excited to lead our team at the international food festival. Our goal was to raise money for a donation to the local children’s home. We decided to set up a lemonade stand because lemonade seemed easy to make, and no other group was planning a drink stand. For the recipe, we needed just four simple ingredients: lemons, sugar, water, and ice. We calculated that 1.5 liters of lemonade would give us about 5 cups.

Our main goal was to maximize profit so we could make a generous donation to the children’s home. I learned that PROFIT equals REVENUE minus COSTS. To keep costs low, we bought our ingredients in bulk, which saved us a lot of money. After calculating everything, our cost per cup came to about $0.70. We decided to sell each cup for $2.00, giving us a profit of $1.30 per cup. We aimed to sell 400 cups over the two days of the festival. That meant our expected revenue was $800, our total costs were about $286, and our expected profit was $514.

We had to think of smart marketing strategies to attract customers. Our location was perfect—right between the tteokbokki and kebab stands, where foot traffic was heavy. We made colorful posters and handed out fliers. To boost our social media presence, we offered free refills to anyone who mentioned us on social media. We also set up a photo zone with a #sweetsuccess tag and gave out 10% discount coupons for the second day.

The festival was a huge success! However, we faced some unexpected costs. We had to buy extra ice because of the hot weather, and the free refills and discount coupons cut into our revenue a bit. In the end, our profit came to $479. We didn’t quite reach our $514 goal, but we were still very happy. We proudly donated the money to the children’s home. Through this experience, I learned a real economics lesson—one that no textbook could have taught me.

det.korean: 수익(revenue)에서 비용(costs)을 빼면 이윤(profit)이다. 기부를 위해 이윤을 최대화하려 했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② profit: REVENUE - COSTS = PROFIT → 기부를 위해 극대화할 대상
❌ ① revenue: 수입 전체 → COSTS를 빼기 전
❌ ③ expense: 비용 → 극대화 대상이 아님
❌ ④ investment: 투자 → 문맥과 무관
det.tip: PROFIT = REVENUE - COSTS: 이윤 = 수입 - 비용
